title: UNLOCK THE VIP EXPERIENCE: YOUR GUIDE TO HQ PREMIUM
excerpt: Want to take your BrainlyHQ journey to the next level? Discover the exclusive perks of the HQ Premium subscription. From daily passive coin generation and massive XP boosts to custom color palettes, find out how upgrading your profile can maximize your rewards and make you stand out.
body:
## What is HQ Premium?

At BrainlyHQ, we love rewarding our most dedicated users. The HQ Premium subscription offers a multitude of benefits designed to speed up your progression and give your profile a unique touch. If you are actively participating in the server economy, this subscription is the ultimate tool to boost your daily stats.

## Economy and Progression Boosts

Upgrading to HQ Premium immediately supercharges your account with powerful multipliers and passive income. Here is what you receive:

- **Daily Income:** You automatically receive 5 coins every 24 hours.
- **Faster Leveling:** Enjoy a permanent 1.5 XP Boost on your activities.
- **Shop Discounts:** You get a flat 10% discount on all shop items.

![](/assets/images/blog/image.png)

## Exclusive VIP Features

Being a premium member is not just about the numbers - it is also about the prestige. The subscription unlocks several exclusive areas and customization options:

- **Premium Zone:** Gain access to a special, restricted chat area.
- **Profile Customization:** Stand out by gaining access to the color palette and a special badge.
- **Advanced Tracking:** Monitor your wealth with access to detailed economy logs.
- **Sneak Peeks:** Be the first to try out new tools with access to pre-release features.

![](/assets/images/blog/image%20%281%29.png)

## How Discounts Work

Planning to use your 10% shop discount? Keep in mind our general discount rules. When using discounts, the general rule is that promotions cannot be combined. This means that if you are eligible for two different promotions, the system will automatically select the most favorable promotion for you. Promotions will only be combined in exceptional cases!

**Are you ready to maximize your BrainlyHQ experience? Check out the server shop to activate your HQ Premium status today!**
